{
  "phoneNote": "The mobile layout has a warm, editorial feel with great imagery and clear pricing, though the giant display title in the footer has colliding lines of text.",
  "desktopNote": "On desktop, the hero image is too tall, pushing the introductory text and primary call-to-action buttons below the fold on the first screen.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 5,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 5,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 5,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the height of the desktop hero image or move the dark green text card higher up so the headline, body copy, and primary CTA button are fully visible on the first screen.",
    "Increase the line-height on the large display business name in the footer so the letters in 'Gostilna' do not collide with the caron on 'Žlici'.",
    "Pair the 'Kdaj smo odprti' opening hours table on desktop with location or contact details in a second column to fill the empty right half of that section."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On phone in the footer, the giant display text 'Gostilna Pri Zlati Žlici' has tight line-height causing the 'l' in 'Gostilna' to overlap the 'Ž' in 'Žlici'.",
    "On the desktop first screen, the hero text box extends past the bottom of the viewport, cutting off the body text and hiding the primary CTA buttons below the fold."
  ]
}
